import pandas as pd
def clean(df):
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    return df
def answer(df):
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
